_about: LOOKOPT: five look changes Dom has not yet approved, shipped DARK. Every 'on' / 'wetDecal' = false is today's look. Flip one switch to true the moment Dom says LOOK OK. Read by Scripts/LookOptions.cs (StreamingAssets copy first, then Assets/Data). The floor and doorway options are applied at runtime after scene load, so no scene or material rebuild is needed.

deathWash._about: hud.json screens.defeatTint (today [0.16, 0.0, 0.015, 1], the maroon end-screen vignette tint) is replaced by tint while on. Only the tint; dimAlpha / band / text untouched.

doorwaySpikeStrip._about: Scene objects (exact name, any depth, inactive included) switched off while on. DoorwayEmberGlow = HdrpDoorway.BuildGlow: additive orange-red crack-texture strip on the tunnel floor below doorway.json glow.height 0.5 m = the red spike strip at the threshold. Add names here if the strip turns out to be another object.

floorNormal._about: HDRP/Lit _NormalScale of the named floor materials while on (today 0.75, look.json ground.materials). Applied at runtime to a private copy of each material; assets are not touched. M_WorldTerrain (0.9) is NOT listed: add it to materials if the far terrain should calm down too.

finisherBlood._about: GoreFx.Splash: the flat unlit Furnace/Particle blood quads (the starburst card) become lit HDRP/Decal projectors (same splat texture, colour gore.color, glossy wet smoothness) while wetDecal is true. Falls back to the quad when HDRP/Decal is missing. The lit droplet particle VFX does NOT exist yet (see MANIFEST).

combatCamCap._about: CamFraming.Fit: the extra pull-back that fits both fighters is limited so the camera is at most followM metres from the look-at point (never below the base V3 pose). Fighters that no longer fit are caught by camera_framing.json fovMax (60).
